# WAVE5_POSITION_DATA_AUDIT_A2 — what the floor-truncated position data can and cannot prove

**Generated by** `scripts/positions/audit-bounds.ts` (read-only, deterministic). **It forces no hero in or out.**

- Positions file: `apps/engine/src/signals/hero-positions.json` · sha256 `a0688df69fcf068e783cc62ea09ea1998bf6552334bfba7cd2af6c980b38ad78` · format **hero-position-observations/v1**
- Packet audited: `WAVE5_DOTA_JUDGE_POST_FIX.json` (git `6c9e5ff`)

## Method

For each hero: S = sum of the listed (>= floor) positions, k = 5 - listed positions, each unlisted count is in [0, floor-1]. True share of a listed position is in [m/(S+k*(floor-1)), m/S]; m/S is what the legacy code used. Dominance can never be overturned; share admissions can only be overturned, never added.
